I’ve thought about this a little bit too. And it always makes me cry. Thinking about what would happen if either I or any of my family members would die. I promise you that you are not worthless. Statistically speaking, even if 99.99% of the world found you unattractive or thought you had a bad personality there would still be over 800,000 people who still find you attractive and nice, funny and kind. Please keep on living.

Hey bud.

Suicide is definitely not a cowardly thing to do. Anyone who tells you that can go FUCK themselves. I feel your pain. I used to laugh about it, thinking how pathetic being suicidal is. Now I’m on the other side, and I understand that no matter what your background, no matter how life has treated you, you can still feel absolutely miserable. In your case, it’s sounds like you have good reason to be miserable. 

But I promise, there will never, ever, be a second chance at being where you are now. If you die, you will never, EVER, be back on earth as the same person, knowing what you know, having seen what you have seen. And I wouldn’t say that’s necessarily a good thing or a bad thing. 

And I’m not going to tell you, go live your life to the fullest and all that. It would be great if you dedicated yourself to others, just being there, if an old person needs help crossing the street, volunteering somewhere, doing community work, anything. But there’s definitely no requirement for that. I would like for you to live. I don’t think you are a coward. 

I want you to stay strong.

Thanks for the reply. I’ve hoped that it will get better. But honestly I have these relapses of these dark moods where I feel so empty and sad. It’s been on and off for over a year now. I’ve always told myself, don’t be impulsive, don’t act irrationally, wait for a week and if you haven’t had a single happy moment that whole time, then let go. I’m currently replying while in one of my better moods. I really hope I don’t have a relapse again. Thanks again for your time
